versions.changelog:
Initial release of aim-digital-human-video.

- Generate digital human talking videos from a user-provided image and audio or text.
- Audio can be uploaded directly, synthesized from preset voices, or cloned from a sample.
- Submits jobs to AEP via /video2 endpoint and polls for video readiness, returning a public video URL.
- Offers intelligent polling based on estimated processing time, with a task history and status tracker.
- All credentials must be configured in a local .env file; supports interactive self-check and guided setup flow.
- Provides command-line scripts for different use cases, with straightforward JSON output.
